question: What does the existing formal/nominal prior permit for one creature class used as remedy material versus affected recipient, and which prior candidate claims actually failed?

scope.reads: Current route, EZ_DECISION, composition topic, word profile metadata/prior evidence, GDT765/766/1091 reports. No raw target dataset, TSV, image, EZauthor, external contact, reserve or Git access. Profile examples and report quotations are disclosed inherited target exposure; no new full target unit was read.

outcome: A shared nominal creature-class hypothesis is compatible with the formal prior. The prior does not distinguish drug identity, creature identity or participant role. Any source-versus-recipient switch must be licensed by paid written attachments in the complete account, not by changing OFCHY itself or inheriting old material glosses as anchors.

formal_observations.claim: Exact OFCHY has four ZL raw groups versus three each in IT/RF, all on three Herbal selectors. Conservative exact positions are f22r.4, f26v.5 and f39v.1; f39v.5 is ZLofchy versus ITopchy/RFopchy.
formal_observations.implication: Three conservative occurrences plus one explicit reading disagreement must be accounted for; alternate readings are not pooled independent confirmations.

formal_observations.claim: Conservative OFCHY positions are medial, without same-line repetition. ZL additionally has one final occurrence.
formal_observations.implication: A recurrent paragraph-opening command or repeated formula claim has contrary geometry. Medial position alone neither proves nominality nor prohibits a command in a different grammar.

formal_observations.claim: GDT766 strict-prefix cohort:25 reader-exact occurrences/13 wholes,21medial/4final/0first, no repeated exact immediate edges. Total containing-ofch cohort:43 exact occurrences/25 wholes.
formal_observations.implication: Early noninitial content-field geometry is supported for this declared observed cohort; no stable neighboring phrase independently names the referent. It cannot be exported as a meaning of ofch or to unseen forms.

formal_observations.claim: GDT765/WE003 retain several neighboring Xdaiin parallels, including OFCHY, SCHOR, OL and DAR predecessors. WE004 independently audits fixed raw group/space fidelity; it does not establish semantic H1, III or nominality.
formal_observations.implication: An account must explain its own tail roles coherently across these stated parallels. Quantity/degree/class readings are assumptions; the parallels do not logically refute a season interpretation without an explicit syntax.

formal_observations.claim: GDT608 formal directed composition and whole-form/context residuals are retained. New stem-pair grammar does not transfer generally; no single proven parser or alphabet.
formal_observations.implication: Preserve written ordering, reusable formal relations and complete-form distinctions. Identical OFCHY may preserve a common denotation across different clause roles; family spellings do not establish a shared global creature/drug morpheme.

permitted_and_constrained.permits: A noun denoting worms/creatures can be remedy material in one clause and a harmed recipient in another; these are participant roles or uses of the referent, not necessarily competing lexical senses.
permitted_and_constrained.requires: Keep the fixed OFCHY denotation and explain which written relation assigns its role in each complete context. Animate class remains a C0 assumption. Nominal compatibility is not meaning evidence.

permitted_and_constrained.permits: Shared creature-class noun, named drug, generic material or opaque catalogue entry can all fill a formal nominal/content slot.
permitted_and_constrained.requires: Do not count GDT765 nominal scoring as an independently established drug/substance ontology. Its dryness/fraction/value interpretations are inherited working assumptions; changed tails require an explicit new account, not automatic old score transfer.

permitted_and_constrained.permits: A nominal recipient can occur medially without being the subject, remedy or imperative.
permitted_and_constrained.requires: Owned ear/location, leafjuice source material and kill/benefit relation must be attached through declared rules. The distributional prior supplies no subject/object/case/recipient marker. Mere adjacent source and creature nouns do not bind source, patient or recipient.

permitted_and_constrained.permits: One lexical creature class can retain identity while source/use and recipient contexts differ.
permitted_and_constrained.requires: The role change must be borne by actual differences outside OFCHY or explicit accounted context; no hidden sense-switch, clause payload or silent change of fixed AS rules.

permitted_and_constrained.permits: Compare observed complete OFCH-containing forms under explicitly bounded hypotheses.
permitted_and_constrained.requires: No global ofch=creature/drug/flower export, free q/y/dy meanings, orthographic-neighbor equivalence or unseen-form prediction from substring resemblance.

consequences_for_EZ: Keep OFCHY=WORMLIKE_CREATURES fixed as required; compare source/remedy versus affected-recipient roles through the other written groups and explicitly owned attachments.
Pay nominal-role pressure and any new role-binding rule as separate assumptions; do not claim that replacing flower with worms has independently disproved the material rival.

A coherent two-case account can be retained atC0. To differ from generic drug/catalogue rivals it must impose distinct written participant/source consequences; equal compatibility leaves semantic ranking unresolved.
After author freeze inspect all conservative occurrences and the fourth ZL disagreement case; neither three alternate readers nor the next mechanically nominated case is independent confirmation.
Keep AS unchanged and its unresolved outside rows/debts visible; do not use the prior report's nominal defaults to erase a typed contradiction or supply an unbound killing relation.
ceiling: This prior audit gives permissions and obligations for exploratory authorship, not a manuscript test or new meaning selection. No exact creature-class claim has been independently tested by the named priors; neither confirmed grammar nor their working scores select worms over drug material.
